title: CROSS-CULTURAL VALUE ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORKS FOR RESPONSIBLE AI GOVERNANCE: EVIDENCE FROM CHINA-WEST COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating human value survey data (e.g., World Values Survey) using a Diversity-Enhanced Framework (DEF) and quantifying the Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KL-D) between predicted LLM distributions and actual country-level human response distributions for U.S. and Chinese cultures.
Mapping demographic preference mismatches and alignment configurations for male versus female personas using the Diversity-Enhanced Framework (DEF) across U.S. and Chinese contexts.

Analyzing representational fidelity and mismatch proportions across specific age cohorts (under 29, 30-49, and over 50) using the Diversity-Enhanced Framework (DEF) to identify generational under-representation.
